# lab-egress

A forward proxy on the lab network, so host tools resolve lab hostnames.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| image | string | `"ghcr.io/querateam/docker-tinyproxy:latest"` | tinyproxy container image. |
| port | null or 16 bit unsigned integer; between 0 and 65535 (both inclusive) | `the lab's slot in `lib/allocation.nix`` | Loopback port the proxy is published on.  Null takes the lab's allocated slot, which is every lab in this tree. Set it to move off one: an allocated port looks free in a table of registered names and may not be — the ranges contain 5353 (mDNS) and 5355 (LLMNR), and a host already running something is a fact no allocation can see.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| network | [LAB_NETWORK](../signatures/LAB_NETWORK.md) | The docker network a lab's containers share, and the gateway address on it. |
| zone | [DNS_ZONE](../signatures/DNS_ZONE.md) | The lab's DNS zone and the server authoritative for it. The only fully portable signature. |

## Requires, optionally

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| resolver | [HOST_RESOLVER](../signatures/HOST_RESOLVER.md) | A resolver on the lab's network, as another container on it reaches it. |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| service | [HOST_SERVICE](../signatures/HOST_SERVICE.md) | A container the lab runs on the host, as `setup-services` starts it. |

## What it emits

Rendered by `cloud` as the lab unit `egress`. A unit of the lab
installs nothing into a cluster, and its provisions are sealed inside the
lab's inclusion — so its declaration above is its interface.
